Sample: fund-quarter panel, opentonewinv==1 and row-count event quarter j in -7..5 (j counts panel rows from the first post-signing row, so it differs from calendar distance when a fund's panel has gaps); additionally restricted to e(sample) of the authors' preceding regression with quarterlyret, fullscore_alt and logfundsize (a non-missing restriction only, flag s_t3). Treatment D = post_pri = 1 from the fund's first post-signing quarter (absorbing in calendar time, verified); gvar = gpost. fixest (fixef.rm = none) reproduces the log: coef 0.04933944 vs 0.0493394, N 1476 vs 1476, clusters 156 vs 156, SE 0.01576713 vs 0.0157671. Regression sample: N = 1476, 156 funds, 41 consecutive quarters. Cohorts (first post-signing quarter): 30, of which 27 have both treated and untreated rows in the sample. In 40 of the 41 treated periods another cohort supplies untreated rows (not-yet-signed funds; no never-treated funds). Funds observed only after signing in the sample (always-treated within sample): 34 (7.0% of rows); funds observed only before signing: 10. Table/column labels are inferred from package folder names and code order (no article text). Outcome winsorized at 0.5/99.5 on the full 105,571-row file before the opentonewinv filter (winsor2 emulated with Stata's _pctile rule = R quantile type 2; the coefficient matches the log to 7 digits).
